text: Firstbase can act as your registered agent, handling compliance on your behalf.
quote: Appoint Firstbase as your Registered Agent — or switch if you already have one — and forget the stress of staying compliant.

text: Switching your registered agent address is handled for you, including agency notifications.
quote: Switching from an existing address? It's effortless. We'll handle agency notifications — so you don't have to.

text: Migrating from another platform or catching up on bookkeeping is handled seamlessly regardless of company size.

text: Firstbase One bundles accounting, compliance, virtual address, and tax subscriptions into one back-office package.

text: Firstbase Loop lets you apply for banking, payments, payroll, and accounting services and get onboarded in seconds.
quote: Apply for banking, payments, payroll, accounting, and more with Firstbase Loop and get onboarded in seconds.

text: Firstbase Discovery exposes your business to a network of VCs as a potential investment opportunity.
quote: Firstbase Discovery allows our network of VCs to view your business as a potential investment opportunity.

text: Compliance dashboard gives an instant per-state overview of company status, requirements, and upcoming deadlines.
quote: Get an instant overview of your company’s status in each state. Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.

text: Payroll product lets you compliantly hire remote employees, run payroll, and file tax returns in all 50 states.
quote: Register for Payroll™ to compliantly hire remote employees, process payroll, and file tax returns. Available in all 50 states.

text: A dedicated bookkeeper is available to answer questions on accounting dates, deadlines, and regulations.
quote: Your bookkeeper is always available to answer any questions about accounting dates, deadlines, regulations.

text: Firstbase can file a tax extension form on your behalf if you subscribe by April 15.

text: You can apply to more than one Firstbase service at once, with application data securely shared with partners.
quote: Yes! You can easily apply to more than one service at a time. Your application information is then securely sent over to our partners for approval.

text: R&D tax credit eligibility is determined for free.

text: You can open a business bank account without needing an EIN first.

text: Virtual mailbox scans and manages physical mail into high-resolution PDFs, replicating email-like actions.

text: Accounting platform includes a dedicated bookkeeper with built-in messaging for direct communication.

text: One-click integrated services let you manage multi-state compliance requirements effortlessly.
quote: Get integrated one-click services to manage more complex compliance across multiple states effortlessly, so your business always stays one step ahead.
